mapper.select: INSERT INTO received_campaign (event_id, payload_hash, campaign_id, ecu_id, lot_no, vehicle_count) VALUES (#{eventId}::uuid, #{payloadHash}, #{campaignId}, #{ecuId}, #{lotNo}, #{vehicleCount}) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING event_id::text
SELECT payload_hash, vehicle_count FROM received_campaign WHERE event_id = #{eventId}::uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO received_campaign_vehicle (event_id, vin, serial_no) VALUES (#{eventId}::uuid, #{v.vin}, #{v.serialNo})
